The '''Maerdocian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], within regiond known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Its Rimward side was traversed by the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], while the sector's coreward boundary marked the end of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

The proximity of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] made the area a contested territory between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which had swollen to include the sector by c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who eventually annexed parts of it by the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], only to lose it during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Chroma Zed system/Legends|Chroma Zed system]] became a source of [[Slavery/Legends|slave labor]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] forces moved across the sector towards [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The same year, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] advanced in a similar manner towards [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The Maerdocian then experienced a period of peace until the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], which saw the [[Deneba system/Legends|Deneba system]] [[Battle of the Deneba system|fall]] to the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders in [[25 ABY/Legends|the first year]] of the conflict. Eventually, the sector fell under the sway of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] by [[137 ABY]].

==Description==
The Maerdocian [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] portion<ref name="aoc-map" /> of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], a region that spanned most of the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] between the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Its coreward boundary was the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] itself, with the other neighbors being&mdash;clockwise&mdash;the [[Eclorar sector/Legends|Eclorar]], [[Daalang sector/Legends|Daalang]], [[Aida sector/Legends|Aida]], [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian]] and [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu]] sectors.<ref name="aoc-map" />

The [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]], traversed the sector near its rimward side, with at least four [[Star system/Legends|systems]] being situated on it.<ref name="aoc-map" /> Out of these, the polluted, swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Scoundrel's Luck">''[[Scoundrel's Luck]]''</ref> [[Shador]] in the [[Shador system/Legends|Shador system]]<ref name="planetrant">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30376893|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-24|time=8:34 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802103104/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-100}}</ref> was home to a notable [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Other planets in the sector included [[Chokan]], [[Chroma Zed]] and [[Deneba/Legends|Deneba]].<ref name="aoc-map" /><ref name="planetrant" />

==History==
The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] marked the beginning of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]] and the subsequent [[Indecta Era]], the settlement of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] began, while a vast portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] between the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] was explored, including the territory of the future Maerdocian sector.<ref name="Atlas" />

Parts of the tract of space containing the sector were under [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government by the onset of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> while the rest of the sector became part of the civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. The Republic managed to preserve its control over the area until the [[New Sith Wars|Draggulch Period]], when large portions of the Rim were abandoned to slow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] advance.<ref name="The Knight Errant Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], following an unsuccessful meeting on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] and the assassination of four of its leaders, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] began its military buildup in earnest, with war matériel from [[Colla IV]] and [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]] being moved to [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]] through the sector. By this time, [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] had expanded as far as to include [[Gyndine system/Legends|Gyndine]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], annexing most of the sector.<ref name="Atlas" />

Sometime prior to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], [[Tarshan Ring Excavations]], a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company operating in the [[Tarshan system/Legends|Tarshan system]] in the sector, approached the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to produce cloned [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] "bulge" in the eastern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and Expansion Region became contested space. The newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sought to take the territory north of the [[Nanth'ri Route]], while the Galactic Republic attempted to reassert its influence over the southern part, which included the sector.<ref name="Atlas" />

After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Declaration of a New Order|emerged]], it committed several atrocities on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The world of Chroma Zed in the [[Chroma Zed system/Legends|Chroma Zed system]]<ref name="planetrant" /> in the northwestern Maerdocian sector also became a source of [[Slavery/Legends|slave labor]].<ref name="Atlas" />

A number of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] factions launched attacks on the galaxy in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], following the crippling of the Empire at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and their [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] pursuers&mdash;two species hailing from [[Firefist|Companion Besh]]&mdash;broke into the Rim territories at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]]. A secondary force of the two [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] advanced north, then turned east, racing across the Expansion Region and the Mid Rim and going through the Maerdocian sector before reaching [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The sector was spared of conflict for the next eleven years.<ref name="Atlas" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], a warrior race from [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|another galaxy]], invaded known space at a location called [[Vector Prime]], where their [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]] were able to break the [[Circumferential hyperspace barrier|galactic barrier]]. During their advance, they attacked [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] from the north eventually capturing the [[Deneba system/Legends|Deneba system]] in the Maerdocian sector by c. [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. However, they surrendered a [[29 ABY/Legends|year later]], when the galactic capital world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was recaptured by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces and riddled of [[Terraforming/Legends|vongforming]].<ref name="Atlas" />

By [[137 ABY]], the sector fell under the authority of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Maerdocian sector was mentioned several times in the appendix of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="Atlas" /> Eventually, ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]'' established its location with [[Modi]]'s map of the [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="aoc-map" />
